kit: 《祭》 / Ji — sound kit for a refined 16-bit pixel-art Chinese folk-horror scene
scene: Soot-black shrine room; one amber bulb; cold window shaft; red altar table with five scratched ancestor portraits; water bowl with a floating eye; incense smoke shaped like a hand; two-headed shadow; wall-facing chair; wet shoes and blue footprints; red thread from table to door; old woman with one milky eye and a faded blue jacket.
generator: MiniMax Design desktop app (running, logged in) — local gateway http://127.0.0.1:8001, POST /api/generate/speech (seedaudio & MiniMax TTS) and POST /api/generate/music (MiniMax Music-3.0)
delivery_format: WAV = PCM 16-bit little-endian, 48 kHz (SFX stereo, voice mono); music = MP3 320 kbps, 48 kHz stereo.
loudness_notes: One-shots peak-normalised between −9 and −3 dBFS; bed loops at −14/−12 dBFS peak (RMS ≈ −26/−29 dBFS) so they sit under dialogue; music at −1.5 dBFS peak for headroom in-engine.
loop_notes: bulb_hum.wav and window_rain.wav are sample-continuous at the wrap (verified: end/start jump is below the 99.9th percentile of adjacent-sample differences). Use standard WebAudio/Audio loop with no gap; do not add silence padding.
limitations: SeedAudio does not expose an exact duration parameter; durations were achieved by trimming/looping the generated source. clock_tick and wet_steps sources contained more events than specified, so a window was selected (see processing).
MiniMax Music-3.0 does not accept a length parameter; the 90 s bed is a 2.0–92.0 s excerpt of a 141.6 s generation.
Voice lines were generated with MiniMax speech-2.8-hd; the returned subtitle JSON matches the submitted Chinese text verbatim, but no human listening pass was possible in this session.
The old-woman breath and door/tick sources were very quiet at source (−39 / −30 / −36 dBFS peak) and were raised in post; check for hiss in-engine at high monitor gain.

files.intended_cue: Diegetic mantel clock off-screen in the shrine room. Tension anchor when the player stops moving; a beat marker for the altar ritual.
files.character: One slow, dull wooden tick with a faint metallic tinkle, a small gear settle and a dry second tick a beat later. Close, no room tail.
files.processing: Source 7.0 s held several soft ticks; cut 3.0 s starting 0.45 s before the strongest transient (t≈1.21 s), 8 ms fade-in, 0.55 s fade-out, peak-normalised to −6 dBFS.

files.intended_cue: Water bowl with the floating eye: one drip lands in the shallow ceramic bowl. Trigger when the eye follows the player or the bowl ripples.
files.character: Wet, close 'plip' into a shallow bowl with a brief ceramic resonance and a smaller settling droplet. Damp, no long reverb.
files.processing: Head 3.6 s of a 4.0 s source, 3 ms fade-in, 0.9 s fade-out, peak-normalised to −3 dBFS.

files.intended_cue: The door at the end of the red thread opening a few inches. Play on the door interaction and again, quieter, when the thread pulls taut.
files.character: Long low dry hinge groan with stick-slip judder and wood grain grinding; door opens a few inches and settles. No slam.
files.processing: 4.0 s from 0.05 s, 20 ms fade-in, 0.5 s fade-out, peak-normalised to −6 dBFS.

files.intended_cue: Six slow wet barefoot steps approaching from the corridor to the shrine threshold; sync with the blue footprints appearing one by one.
files.character: Bare wet soles peeling and slapping cracked concrete, starting distant and ending close, with a slight tiled hallway echo. No voice.
files.processing: 6.0 s window from 0.55 s of an 8.0 s source (the source contained more than six step events; this window carries the six-step approach), +7 dB linear approach ramp, 20 ms fade-in, 0.6 s fade-out, peak-normalised to −6 dBFS.

files.intended_cue: The wall-facing chair dragging once across concrete — the moment it is turned around.
files.character: One abrupt, dry wooden scrape with a short friction rasp and a tiny wood creak, then dead silence.
files.processing: 2.0 s from 0.03 s, 5 ms fade-in, 0.5 s fade-out, peak-normalised to −5 dBFS.

files.intended_cue: Incense smoke that shapes itself into a hand. Underlay when the smoke bends toward the player.
files.character: Dry, granular smoke hiss close to the capsule with one soft nasal breath; whisper-like but wordless. Quiet and almost subliminal.
files.processing: 5.0 s from 0.15 s of an 8.5 s source, 50 ms fade-in, 0.7 s fade-out, peak-normalised to −9 dBFS (deliberately faint).

files.intended_cue: Bed loop for the single amber bulb: mains hum and filament crackle under the whole shrine scene.
files.character: Low 50 Hz-family electrical hum with faint filament crackle and slow flicker pulses, very quiet room behind it. Steady and loopable.
files.processing: Seamless 6.0 s loop built by equal-power head overlap-add (0.5 s, source offset 10.0 s) so the wrap is sample-continuous; peak-normalised to −14 dBFS (RMS ≈ −26 dBFS).

files.intended_cue: Bed loop for the cold window shaft: night rain and wind pressing on the wooden shutter, heard from inside.
files.character: Muffled low rain and wind against a closed shutter, no thunder, no drips. Steady night exterior pressure.
files.processing: Seamless 12.0 s loop built by equal-power head overlap-add (1.5 s, source offset 13.3 s); peak-normalised to −12 dBFS (RMS ≈ −29 dBFS).

files.intended_cue: Close on the old woman's one milky eye while she holds still; loop softly under her dialogue if the shot lingers.
files.character: Ragged, shallow, slightly wet breathing, frightened and keeping still, recorded very close. No voice, no words.
files.processing: 6.0 s from 0.1 s, 80 ms fade-in, 0.7 s fade-out, peak-normalised to −9 dBFS (the raw source peaked at −39 dBFS; +30 dB of make-up gain).

files.intended_cue: Sparse ritual score bed for exploration and the five-portrait altar ritual. Sit it under room tone at roughly −26 LUFS-ish; no stingers, so hits stay diegetic.
files.character: Near-static: low sub drone, a bowed cello harmonic drifting out of tune, a distant small ritual bell every ~20 s, breath-like tape texture. No drums, no melody loop, no vocals. Patient and funereal.
files.processing: 141.6 s generated; used 2.0–92.0 s (90.0 s), 2 s fade-in, 4.5 s fade-out, peak-normalised to −1.5 dBFS, encoded MP3 320 kbps / 48 kHz stereo.

files.intended_cue: She asks for the hand — the altar/eye beat, close and quiet, as if standing just behind the microphone.
files.character: Old village woman, low and hoarse, quiet and close, unhurried and unsettling rather than theatrical.
files.processing: Decoded from 32 kHz mono MP3; 70 Hz high-pass + gentle 2:1 compression; trimmed to speech + 0.18 s tail; 8 ms/60 ms fades; 48 kHz mono WAV, peak −3 dBFS.

files.intended_cue: Player raises the camera / the DV light hits her; she notices and asks, still not turning her head.
files.character: Same old woman, a shade more pressed and fearful, still close and breathy.
files.processing: Same chain: 70 Hz high-pass + 2:1 compression, trim + 0.18 s tail, 8/60 ms fades, peak −3 dBFS, 48 kHz mono.

files.intended_cue: The two-headed shadow / the moment she turns from the wall. Play once, let the last syllable sit in the room.
files.character: Quiet, resigned, almost a mutter; the weariness is the scare.
files.processing: Same chain: 70 Hz high-pass + 2:1 compression, trim + 0.18 s tail, 8/60 ms fades, peak −3 dBFS, 48 kHz mono.

runtime_build.format: One-shot SFX and voice lines converted from WAV to 128 kbps MP3 at 44.1 kHz for the shelf build; source WAVs are in assets/audio/source/.
runtime_build.loops: ambience_45s.mp3 and music_eerie_bed_90s.mp3 are music beds; window_rain.wav and bulb_hum.wav remain WAV for seamless looping.
runtime_build.load_check: 24/24 runtime audio files loaded in Chromium via file:// (readyState 4, no media errors).
